data.name: Hotel Fleur D'épée
data.address: 49 Rte du Bas du Fort, Le Gosier 97190, Guadeloupe
data.description:
Set in 3 long, 2-story buildings next to the beach, this relaxed seaside resort is 2 km from Aquarium de la Guadeloupe and 4 km from the city of Pointe-à-Pitre.
The tropical-inspired rooms provide flat-screen TVs and free Wi-Fi, as well as minifridges. All also offer sofas, as well as terraces or balconies, some with sea views. Suites add separate lounges and deck-style terraces.
Freebies include parking, and breakfast served in a casual buffet restaurant. There's also a lively bar. Other amenities include an outdoor pool, beach access and a dive center, plus a kids' club. Wakeboarding and windsurfing classes are available.
